user.title: Meet your home's brain
user.description: Give it a name. This is what it calls itself and how it appears in Home Assistant.

speech.title: How should the house speak?
speech.description: Pick the voice satellites it can talk through. It speaks where people are (motion, or someone talking to a speaker), otherwise on the default speaker.

data_description.motion_window: How many minutes of motion history to weigh up when deciding where people are.
data_description.suppress_entities: e.g. your doorbell announcement, so background remarks don't talk over it.
data_description.prompt_memories: How many memories are given to the voice assistant up front. The rest can still be searched.
data_description.pass_through_areas: Hallways, landings and stairs. Walking through these counts for much less, so a passer-by doesn't steal an announcement.
data_description.all_occupied: On: everyone who's home hears it. Off: only the busiest room.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Used by camera watches. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's preferred AI task.
data_description.camera_cooldown: A camera watch looks again at most this often, to keep AI costs down.
data_description.fallback_speakers: Only used when nobody is in any other speaker's room, e.g. a living room you'd rather not disturb.
data_description.daily_ai_limit: Background camera checks stop for the day after this many. Questions you ask still get answered.
data_description.notice_entities: When these change, the AI decides whether it's worth saying something (or asking). e.g. washing machine, doors, weather, bins.
data_description.chattiness: Limits remarks per hour: quiet 2, normal 4, chatty 8. Off stops noticing.
data_description.house_rules: Plain sentences every voice must follow, one per line, e.g. 'Never say the house is empty.'
data_description.learn_entities: Lights, switches, fans and blinds people use by hand. Every night the last two weeks are checked for things done at about the same time most days, and for things done straight after something else (a door opening, another light going on).
data_description.link_triggers: Optional: more things that might set off a habit (the TV starting, a bed sensor…). Doors, windows and the learned lights are always considered.
data_description.suggest_routines: Once per new routine, during the day when someone's home, ask whether the house should do it from now on.
data_description.door_camera: Looked at once when the doorbell rings, to log who came.
data_description.door_triggers: The doorbell button (a binary sensor or event), or anything else that means someone's at the door.
data_description.announce_visitors: Off keeps it to a quiet log that voice assistants can answer from.
data_description.parcel_alerts: After a delivery, look again a few minutes later and say if a parcel has been left.
data_description.doorstep_sensors: Optional: person sensors for the doorstep or front garden (e.g. a Frigate zone's person occupancy). When a visit there ends without the bell, the door camera is checked once for a parcel or post left behind.
data_description.face_sensor: Optional: a face-recognition sensor whose state is the name it just recognised (e.g. from Frigate). Used in the log, and in the announcement if that's on.
data_description.sidebar_panel: A page in the sidebar showing memories, routines, watches, visitors and what's been said.
data_description.chat_agent: Who answers the page's Ask box — pick a voice agent that has Sentient ticked. Empty uses your preferred Assist pipeline.
data_description.health_ignore: Entities (and their devices) that shouldn't count as problems, e.g. something that's meant to be off.

data_description.door_triggers: The doorbell button (a binary sensor or event), or anything else that means someone's at the door.
data_description.announce_visitors: Off keeps it to a quiet log that voice assistants can answer from.
data_description.parcel_alerts: After a delivery, look again a few minutes later and say if a parcel has been left.
data_description.doorstep_sensors: Optional: person sensors for the doorstep or front garden (e.g. a Frigate zone's person occupancy). When a visit there ends without the bell, the door camera is checked once for a parcel or post left behind.
data_description.face_sensor: Optional: a face-recognition sensor whose state is the name it just recognised (e.g. from Frigate). Used in the log, and in the announcement if that's on.

data_description.chat_agent: Who answers the page's Ask box — pick a voice agent that has Sentient ticked. Empty uses your preferred Assist pipeline.
data_description.health_ignore: Entities (and their devices) that shouldn't count as problems, e.g. something that's meant to be off.
data_description.second_opinion_ai: Optional: a bigger model asked only when the usual one says the picture is too dark or unclear to be sure. Counts towards the daily limit.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify entities, e.g. the Home Assistant app on each phone or watch.
data_description.notify_when: Each kind is sent at most once in ten minutes.
data_description.chime: Off: announcements and questions start straight away, without the speaker's chime.
data_description.welcome_home: When someone gets back after 20 minutes or more, say "Welcome back" in the room they're in — plus what's worth knowing from while they were out (visitors, things that finished, problems). Never in quiet hours, hush or guest mode.
data_description.speak_volume: Optional: the speaker's volume while Sentient talks, put back afterwards. Empty leaves it alone.
data_description.night_volume: Optional: a quieter level for anything said in quiet hours (urgent messages only).
data_description.duck_media: Anything playing in the same room is turned down while Sentient talks, then turned back up.
data_description.critical_alerts: Smoke, carbon monoxide, gas, water-leak and tamper sensors are found automatically, and so is the alarm going off. Said on every speaker, through quiet hours, hush and guest mode, repeated twice while still on, and sent to phones.
data_description.energy_insight: Today's use of the devices on the Energy dashboard compared with the past week: the Energy card, the briefing section, the voice tool and notes on unusual use. Off hides and stops all of it.
data_description.energy_price: Optional: your unit rate, to show today's cost.
data_description.left_open_minutes: Said once (then every half hour while still open), within quiet hours and shushes as usual. 0 turns it off.
data_description.leaving_check: When the last person leaves, anything open or unlocked goes on the timeline and to phones ("Left open").
data_description.critical_extra: Anything else that should always be said everywhere when it turns on, e.g. a panic button or a freezer-too-warm sensor. An alarm panel going off is always included.
data_description.heating_entities: Thermostats to learn from. Leave empty for every one in the house. It learns how fast each warms up and the temperature it's usually set to.
data_description.preheat: Start the heating early so it's at the usual temperature by the time people normally get up. A thermostat with its own schedule is put back on it afterwards, and one that's switched off is left off.
data_description.comfort_temp: Optional: the temperature to warm up to. Leave empty to use the one it's usually set to during the day.
data_description.inside_sensors: Optional: which motion sensors mean someone's inside. Leave empty to use the ones on the same floors as the speakers (garden and camera sensors don't count). Used for night watch and getting-up times.
data_description.weekly_report: On Sunday evenings, put what the house learned and noticed this week on the timeline (sent to phones if digests are).
data_description.night_watch: Learns when each door, gate and window normally opens. An opening at a time it never usually does, with nobody moving inside first, is an alert. If someone was up inside (leaving for work, say), it's only noted.
data_description.night_watch_entities: Leave empty for every door, window, gate and garage door sensor.
data_description.night_watch_announce: An unusual opening with nobody up is said straight away, through quiet hours, hush and guest mode — it could be someone who shouldn't be there.
data_description.warm_by_weekdays: Optional: when it should be warm on weekdays. Leave empty to use the learned getting-up time.
data_description.warm_by_weekends: Optional: the same for Saturdays and Sundays.
data_description.heating_limit: When someone turns the heating up or on by voice or in the app, put it back (to its schedule, or off) after this many hours. 0 never does.
data_description.personality: How the house sounds — in remarks, briefings, welcomes and to every voice assistant.
data_description.personality_notes: Optional, in your own words, e.g. 'Fond of the cats. Teases gently about how much tea gets made.'
data_description.camera_security: Follow people from camera to camera, and alert for someone in the garden when the gate and doors didn't open, or anyone about at night with nobody up. Alerts are said out loud in quiet hours if night watch does.
data_description.camera_security_sensors: Each camera's (or zone's) person sensor, e.g. Frigate's 'Gate person occupancy'.
data_description.camera_security_inside: The person sensors for places behind the gate or fence — the garden, the shed. Someone appearing there without a way in opening is an alert.
data_description.camera_security_entries: The gate and doors people should come through (e.g. the back gate and the back door).
data_description.camera_security_describe: One AI look at the camera for each alert ('a man in a dark hoodie trying the shed door').
data_description.party_lights: The lights that join in when not using the whole house. Leave empty to use the room of whoever asks (or say a room: 'disco mode in the living room').
data_description.party_style: Disco: quick colour changes. Party: bright colours, short fades. Rainbow: a colour wheel. Chill: slow, dim colours. Halloween: flickering orange, purple and green. Christmas: red, green and warm white, twinkling.
data_description.party_minutes: Then every light goes back exactly as it was. 0 keeps going until it's turned off.
data_description.party_whole_house: Every light that can dim or change colour joins in (light groups, screens and backlights don't). Say 'disco mode everywhere' to do this just once.
data_description.party_exclude: Left out of every show, even 'everywhere' — tablet screens, a projector, a bedroom where someone sleeps.
data_description.party_sound: Optional: a loudness sensor in dB, such as a voice speaker's microphone through ESPHome's sound_level sensor. Disco, party, rainbow and Halloween then follow the music — louder is brighter, and each beat changes colour.
data_description.party_show: Which shows get a button on the overview. Leave empty for none; every show still works by voice.
data_description.party_sound_switch: Optional: a switch that makes the loudness sensor report (so it isn't sending readings all day). It's turned on while a show follows the sound and off afterwards. Found automatically if it's on the same device and has 'loudness' in its name.

memories.title: Memories
memories.description: The house remembers {count} things. Pick one to edit, tick any to forget, or add a new one.

briefing.title: Briefings
briefing.description: What a briefing covers — from the BRIEFING button, by voice, or at a set time each day.

data_description.briefings: Off turns off the button, the voice tool and the service.
data_description.briefing_weather: Leave empty to use the first weather entity.
data_description.briefing_system: e.g. CPU temperature, disk use, the NAS. Pending updates are always counted.
data_description.briefing_time: Optional. Only spoken if someone's home and it isn't quiet hours.
data_description.digest_time: Optional: once a day the AI sums up the timeline in a few sentences. It goes on the timeline (and to phones if chosen). Not spoken.
data_description.morning_briefing: Once a day, the first time someone's moving about after quiet hours end (before noon), in that room.

options.held_quiet: Things held back in quiet hours
options.unheard: Things nobody could hear (no speaker available)
options.security: Things left open when everyone goes out

say.name: Say
say.description: Speak through the house, following quiet hours and room awareness.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Urgent ignores quiet hours and hush periods; low never interrupts.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: A speaker, room name or entity id. Leave empty to follow the person.

remember.name: Remember
remember.description: Add something to the house's long-term memory.

category.name: Category
category.description: What kind of memory this is.

forget.name: Forget
forget.description: Remove a memory by id or by matching text.

what.name: What
what.description: Memory id or words from it.

watch.name: Watch
watch.description: Keep an eye on a device, sensor or camera and speak up when something happens.

what.name: What
what.description: Short description, e.g. 'the cats near the rabbit pen'.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: Entity id, name, or a camera's area name.

to_state.name: To state
to_state.description: Fire when the entity reaches this state.

above.name: Above

below.name: Below
below.description: Fire when the value goes below this.

question.name: Question
question.description: Camera watches: a yes/no question about the picture.

look_for.name: Look for
look_for.description: Camera watches: object to wake on, e.g. person, cat, car.

message.name: Message
message.description: What to say. Leave empty for an automatic sentence.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Or how many minutes to watch for.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: Where to say it. Leave empty to follow people.

wake_on.name: Wake on
wake_on.description: Camera watches: a zone or object sensor to wake on instead of the camera's own sensors.

spot.name: Spot
spot.description: Camera watches: only check this named spot (taught by voice, e.g. 'the rabbit pen').

what.name: What
what.description: Watch id or words from it.

remind.name: Remind
remind.description: Say something at a time, in the room where people are.

message.name: Message
message.description: What to say, e.g. 'Time to put the oven on.'

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: Where to say it. Leave empty to follow people.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Urgent (default) still speaks during quiet hours.

ask.name: Ask
ask.description: Ask a question out loud and listen for the answer, in the room where people are.

question.name: Question
question.description: e.g. 'Fancy a brew? Shall I put the kettle on?'

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Urgent ignores quiet hours and hush periods.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: Where to ask. Leave empty to follow people.

extra_prompt.name: Extra instructions
extra_prompt.description: Extra guidance for the voice agent handling the reply.

learn.name: Learn now
learn.description: Look for routines in recent history straight away instead of waiting for tonight.

briefing.name: Briefing
briefing.description: A short briefing of what matters right now, spoken where people are.

speak.name: Speak it
speak.description: Off returns the facts without speaking or using the AI.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Urgent speaks even in quiet hours, e.g. when someone pressed a button for it.

tidy_memories.name: Tidy memories
tidy_memories.description: Merge duplicates and drop nonsense from memory now (also runs every Sunday night).

forget_routine.name: Delete learned routine
forget_routine.description: Delete a learned routine or habit for good — the house stops doing it and never learns or offers it again. With Restore on, bring deleted ones back (one, or all if Routine is empty).

routine.name: Routine
routine.description: Routine id or words from it.

adopt_routine.name: Adopt routine
adopt_routine.description: Have the house do a learned routine by itself, or stop. Leave Adopt empty to toggle.

routine.name: Routine
routine.description: Routine id or words from it.

adopt.name: Adopt
adopt.description: On to start, off to stop.

hush.name: Hush
hush.description: Say nothing that isn't urgent for a while. 0 minutes stops hushing.

run_routine.name: Run routine
run_routine.description: Run a named routine (set up on the sidebar page's Settings → Routines).

name.name: Name
name.description: The routine's name or one of its other names.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: Say the result where people are.

weekly_report.name: Weekly report
weekly_report.description: Put together what the house learned and noticed in the last week, and keep it on the timeline.

party.name: Light show
party.description: Start or stop a light show (disco, Halloween, Christmas…). Lights go back exactly as they were when it stops.

on.name: On
on.description: Off stops it and puts the lights back.

style.name: Style
style.description: Disco, party, rainbow, chill, Halloween or Christmas. Empty uses the setting.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Stop by itself after this long (0 = until turned off). Empty uses the setting.

area.name: Room
area.description: Use this room's lights (or 'everywhere' for every light).
